question: Should OpenClaw reserve a new top-level `openclaw auth` namespace for this read-only auth-profile shortcut, or keep auth-profile inspection only under `openclaw models auth list` for now?
rationale: The code delegation is narrow, but root CLI namespaces are user-facing API and can affect plugin command ownership; current main already solves profile inspection through the documented models command.

options.title: Keep models-only for now
options.body: Leave `openclaw models auth list` as the canonical core surface and close or defer this shortcut until a broader auth namespace is planned.

options.title: Sponsor the shortcut
options.body: Accept `openclaw auth list` as a core alias after live CLI proof is added and the release-owned changelog edit is removed.

options.title: Defer broader auth design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether a root `auth` namespace should cover list, login, remove, and order commands consistently.

recommendation.title: Keep models-only for now
recommendation.body: Leave `openclaw models auth list` as the canonical core surface and close or defer this shortcut until a broader auth namespace is planned.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing models auth CLI surface and many related docs/runtime decisions trace through this owner history.
